youtubeTitle: She has walked into roughly 550 villages in a Naxal-affected district most organizations avoided ...
caption:
She has walked into roughly 550 villages in a Naxal-affected district most organizations avoided - for almost 40 years.

Dr. Budhri Tati, known as 'Badi Didi,' was born into a tribal family in the Hiranar/Geedam area of Dantewada district, Chhattisgarh and lost her father in infancy. Since the mid-1980s, when most organizations avoided the Naxal-affected Bastar region, she has walked on foot across an estimated 545-570 villages over roughly 35-40 years, doing grassroots work in women's education, tribal welfare, health and de-addiction - helping educate and empower several hundred tribal women along the way. She was named a Padma Shri recipient for 2026, announced January 25, 2026. Four decades, hundreds of villages, one woman who kept showing up where almost no one else would.
